description: NTU COOL (Canvas LMS) MCP — read courses/assignments/submissions/announcements/files, plus human-confirmed grade and announcement writes
long_description: MCP server for NTU COOL, National Taiwan University's Canvas LMS deployment. Confirmed via live verification (PsychQuant/ntu-claude-plugins#17) that NTU COOL is a customized Canvas deployment with a fully open standard Canvas REST API. Reads courses, assignments, announcements, submission/grading status, files, and enrollments. Writes (grades, announcements) follow the Foresay confirmation protocol and are gated twice: the server asks the user directly via MCP elicitation (the model cannot skip or answer it), and a single-use token binds the write to the exact payload a human previewed, so approving one thing and writing another is refused. Fail-closed: a client without elicitation support cannot write at all. Requires a Canvas Personal Access Token in the macOS keychain (service `ntu-cool-canvas`) — never read from an environment variable or written to disk.
name: che-ntucool-mcp

tools.name: list_courses

tools.description: List announcements posted in a course
tools.name: list_announcements

tools.description: List submission/grading status for every student in a course
tools.name: list_submissions

tools.description: List files uploaded to a course
tools.name: list_files

tools.description: List the enrollment roster for a course
tools.name: list_enrollments

tools.description: STEP 1 of 2 for posting grades. Renders current grade → new grade per student and returns a payload-bound confirmation_token. Performs no write.
tools.name: preview_grade_change

tools.description: STEP 2 of 2. Writes grades after asking the user to confirm in their own dialog. Requires the token from preview_grade_change with an identical payload. Students are notified; cannot be undone.
tools.name: post_grades

tools.description: STEP 1 of 2 for posting an announcement. Renders what would be published and to how many people, and returns a payload-bound confirmation_token. Performs no write.
tools.name: preview_announcement

tools.description: STEP 2 of 2. Publishes the announcement after asking the user to confirm in their own dialog. Requires the token from preview_announcement with identical title and message. Students are notified; cannot be un-sent.
tools.name: post_announcement
